name: Roma Satybaldiev
source:
The brother of Ulyana. He plays the bass, as well as knows how to give people proper piercings, and is generally good at fixing machines and such. He's generally well collected and seems hard to approach due to his appearance. He has a pet golden retriever, and likes the band MSI.

While his age is unknown, he is an adult, and owns his own home.
